notes: The Public Utilities Board fixes rates, tolls and charges and the conditions of service of Manitoba's utilities under this Act, including Manitoba Hydro's electricity and natural-gas rates; Manitoba Hydro's own powers are in The Manitoba Hydro Act, C.C.S.M. c. H190.
